title: Condition on missing the payload key before attempting adaptive recovery
statement: The accepted public-key forward-memoryless-query subclass has a minimax recovery lower bound from the probabilityu_nof never hitting the payload key. On this event the reference decouples even with later adaptive queries; guaranteed exact heralded success is at most1-u_n. Supplied rank is not freely inferred from finite samples.
